title: content/chapter_select/chapter_select.json
description: M7-04 — the loc keys the Chapter Select screen (S04) renders. What is fixed here is that the screen shows a title, one name per difficulty tier, one caption per way a tier can be refused, one status line per state the screen can be in while its list is not yet an answer, and a confirm caption — and that every one of them is a key rather than a literal (X-04). Every value is a loc key, so ContentInvariants.CheckLocaleKeyReferences resolves it against every locale file: a key this document names but a locale does not carry fails the build, and a locale string this document stops naming fails it as an orphan. The tier member set mirrors the DifficultyTier vocabulary, which is authored in tuning/progression.json#/chapterGating and in par_power.json's tier columns; adding a fourth tier is a tuning decision that would fail here until this schema was widened deliberately. additionalProperties is false throughout, so there is no slot for a par-power or expected-power warning: that readout belongs to the row that owns the power model, and a caption here would invite a screen-side power comparison ahead of it.

locKey.description: loc.<domain>.<id>.<field>, lowercase, dot-separated, snake_case segments — the same shape schema/loc.schema.json governs the locale files by.

title.description: The screen's own heading. Chapter names are not here — each chapter document carries its own displayName key.

tier.description: One name per difficulty tier. The member set is closed and required in full: a tier with no name renders as a blank picker entry, which is indistinguishable from a tier that does not exist.

block.description: One caption per KIND of unmet requirement — a clear that has not happened, and a Legend Level that has not been reached. Two rather than one, because they are fixed by doing two different things. WHICH clear or WHICH level is carried in code as a payload rather than baked into a sentence here: there is no string-interpolation runtime in this repository yet, and a caption per (chapter, tier) pair would be a translation bill that grows with the campaign.

status.description: One line per state the screen can be in while its list is not yet an answer. Three rather than one, and required in full: the list is dimmed and non-interactive in all three, so with no words they are indistinguishable — and only the first of them ever ends on its own, while the other two are dead ends a player would otherwise wait out forever. There is deliberately no member here for a retry, a reload or an error panel: the failure screen and its retry ladder belong to the row that owns them, and a slot here would invite building a second one.

confirm.description: The caption on the control that submits START_RUN for the chosen chapter and tier.
